scenario: [LINT.6.1]: `duration` is a component only of an interval over `Time` or `Date`, so `(w.a .. w.b).duration` on two `Int` slots is refused with DS_VALIDATE_BAD_INTERVAL_COMPONENT. An `Int` interval is itself legal ([LINT.1.1]), so the refusal is the component's alone. A component reader that types `duration` as `Duration` for every interval compiles this. `compiler/LINT.6.2_duration` is the `Time` control.
